name: Marine
description: Members of the armed fighting forces carried aboard starships. Marines deal with boarding actions, piracy, and ground battles.

assignments.name: Support
assignments.description: You are a support specialist, engineer, or logistics operative for the Marines.

assignments.name: Star Marine
assignments.description: You are trained for boarding actions and zero-gravity combat.

assignments.name: Ground Assault
assignments.description: You are trained for planetary surface operations and ground combat.

events.description: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Mishap table but remain in career.

effects.detail: Roll on Mishap table, stay in career

events.description: You are on the front lines of a planetary assault and occupation.
events.effectDescription: Gain one of Recon 1, Gun Combat 1, Leadership 1 or Electronics (Comms) 1.

effects.detail: Gain Recon 1, Gun Combat 1, Leadership 1 or Electronics (Comms) 1

events.description: You are assigned to the security forces of a space station.
events.effectDescription: Gain one of Vacc Suit 1 or Athletics (Dexterity) 1.

events.description: You are given a special assignment or duty.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.

events.description: You are thrown into a brutal ground war.
events.effectDescription: Roll Gun Combat or Melee 8+. Succeed: gain Leadership or Tactics (Military). Fail: roll on the Injury table.

effects.detail: Gun Combat/Melee 8+ for Leadership/Tactics or Injury

events.description: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Life Events table.

events.description: You are given advanced training in a specialist field.
events.effectDescription: Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.

events.description: A mission goes wrong and you have to rescue a fellow Marine.
events.effectDescription: Roll either Melee or Athletics 8+. Succeed: gain an Ally. Fail: roll on the Injury table.

events.description: You are assigned to a black ops mission.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll.

events.description: Your commanding officer takes an interest in your career.
events.effectDescription: Either gain Tactics (Military) 1 or DM+4 to your next advancement roll (choose one).

effects.detail: Tactics (Military) 1 or DM+4 to next advancement

events.effectDescription: You may gain a promotion or a commission automatically.

mishaps.effectDescription: Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.

effects.detail: Roll twice on Injury table, take lower result

mishaps.description: A mission goes wrong; you and several others are captured and held as prisoners of war. Gain your jailer as a Contact and gain one of Persuade 1, Medic 1, Streetwise 1 or Deception 1.
mishaps.effectDescription: Gain a Contact (jailer). Gain Persuade 1, Medic 1, Streetwise 1 or Deception 1.

effects.detail: Gain Persuade 1, Medic 1, Streetwise 1 or Deception 1

mishaps.description: A mission goes wrong and you are stranded behind enemy lines. Gain Survival 1 or Stealth 1.

You are ordered to take part in a black ops mission that goes against your conscience. If you refuse, you are ejected from the career. Accept and gain one of Tactics (Military) 1 or Gun Combat 1 but also gain the commanding officer as an Enemy.
mishaps.effectDescription: Refuse: ejected. Accept: gain Tactics/Gun Combat and commander as Enemy.

mishaps.description: You are tormented by or quarrel with an officer or fellow Marine. Gain that individual as a Rival as they drive you out of the service.
Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
